data.name: Oath of Steel
data.detailed_description:
🚛 Post-apocalyptic wasteland × tank romance

After the legendary "Intelligent Machinery Crisis", civilization crumbled into dust, with ferocious monsters and powerful bounty hunters roaming the world. As an extraterrestrial visitor, your only companion is a rumbling tank. Drive it through barren deserts and dilapidated ruins, challenge enemies with vastly different strengths, and uncover the secrets buried deep beneath the wasteland - this is the romance of a tough guy, and also the beginning of your story.

💔 Despite the simple plot, there are plenty of heart-stirring moments

The game narrative returns to a "concise yet touching" style, without redundant dialogue to disrupt the pace. The world is cruel, but the girl around you is warm. On your adventure journey, you will encounter cute sisters, taciturn warriors, and arrogant rich girls... and embark on a series of life-and-death adventures. *With a clear harem plotline, there is no need for concern. Both combat and emotions are part of your journey.

🛸 Combat Vehicle System: The Romance of Men

As a tribute to the classic, the game's core returns to the "dual system of human and tank". You can deeply customize the tank in the modification workshop: activate acupoints, replace the engine, equip the main and secondary guns, transforming it into a steel beast that crushes everything. Different tank chassis have different characteristics and configurations. When facing a specific bounty hunter, choosing the right armament will determine the outcome of the battle.

🔥 Rich Bounty: A Life-and-Death Battle

Hunting is the only law of survival. On the vast wasteland lurk more than 20 unique bounties - from gigantic sharks that inhabit the depths of the ocean to vicious war machines with fierce firepower hidden deep in the desert. Some enemies even require you to flexibly switch between melee combat and tank battles, seeking vulnerabilities. Every duel is an extreme test of equipment and courage.

📖 Featured System

Free exploration and nonlinear narrative: Go wherever you want, without mandatory quest lines.

Elemental Reactions: Innovatively added some elemental reactions (new reactions will continue to be added in subsequent works), making team speed matching and tank equipment configuration more interesting, rather than simply stacking high-value equipment.

Painting & Transformation System: Customize the body and weapons of your tank freely; dismantled tank weapons can be used for transformation: freely modify your cool tank!

War Tank Manufacturing: Players can obtain war tank blueprints during their adventures and craft some enemy war tanks!

Weapon crafting: Obtain weapon blueprints through adventures, and create more personalized characters and war vehicle equipment!

💾 "Wild Romance: Wasteland Expedition" is a love letter to classic tank RPGs, and also a personally crafted adventure in a romantic harem setting. Add it to your wishlist, lead your girl squad, and crush this silent world!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: win7/win10
  • Processor: intel Core i5-6400 or AMD FX 8320
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

  • Processor: intel Core i7-7700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
